text:
lena: Hey folks, landing in Berlin Fri after the all-hands. Staying near Kreuzberg. Want to grab something casual with the team after the day? Looking for classic Berlin street food vibes : currywurst, dner, or something sit-down?

marco: For Kreuzberg I always go to Mustafas Gems Kebap for doner (quick, iconic). Curry 36 is touristic but great late-night.

oliver: If you want sit-down, Markthalle Neun has lots of stalls, not too slow and good for groups. Also, tried a small vegan place called Vego Foodworld nearby and it was solid.

zoe: Love Markethalle Neun for variety. Quick poll: :meat_on_bone: Mustafas (doner), :hot_pepper: Curry 36 (currywurst), :bento: Markthalle Neun (sit & share), :seedling: Vego (vegan)

marco: :meat_on_bone:

oliver: :bento:

lena: :meat_on_bone: leaning kebab for authenticity and speed. Whats the latest ppl want for ~8pm?

zoe: If we hit Mustafas we can then wander to a bar after. If ppl want fewer stairs and a table, Markthalle Neun it is.

marco: Heads up Mustafas can have a line but moves fast. Markthalle has seating but can get noisy.

lena: OK locking in Mustafas around 20:00 unless objections. Will DM anyone who wants to join earlier.

ops-bot: calendar: Event created "Kreuzberg Afterparty lena + team" Friday 20:00-21:30 provisional. Attendees: lena, marco, oliver, zoe.

lena: Quick addresses for pins: ```Mustafas Gems Kebap  - Mehringdamm 32, 10961 Berlin
Curry 36 - Mehringdamm 36, 10961 Berlin
Markthalle Neun - Eisenbahnstrara 10997 Berlin
Vego Foodworld - Adalbertstraa 10999 Berlin```

zoe: If anyone wants to hop earlier for a quick drink, meet at the hotel lobby at 19:30.

marco: See you all Friday !
